questions.question: ROI formula ที่ถูกต้องคืออะไร?
questions.explanation: ROI = (Savings - Cost) / Cost × 100%. This shows the percentage return relative to the investment. Positive means profit; negative means loss.

questions.question: ถ้า cost > savings (ROI เป็น negative) break-even weeks ควร return อะไร?
questions.explanation: When costs exceed savings, the investment will never break even. Infinity correctly represents an impossible break-even point — the tool will always cost more than it saves.

questions.question: totalCost สำหรับ 1 quarter (3 เดือน) คำนวณจากอะไร?
questions.explanation: Total cost for a quarter = teamSize × monthlyCostPerDev × 3 months. This represents the total investment for a 3-month period.
